work_info.title: What is Fashion Image Editing?
descriptions: Fashion Image Editing is the professional enhancement of fashion photographs to elevate brand perception, visual appeal, and storytelling. It refines every element of the image while preserving authenticity, helping brands, designers, and photographers present polished, high-impact visuals.

list.content: Skin & Fabric Retouching: Refining skin tones and garment textures while maintaining realism.
Color Grading & Lighting Enhancement: Adjusting tones for vibrant, premium-looking visuals.
Background Cleanup & Replacement: Removing distractions to keep focus on the subject and outfit.
Detail Enhancement: Sharpening accessories, patterns, and styling elements.
Brand-Consistent Finishing: Delivering images aligned with fashion brand aesthetics and campaign needs.
